source_title: ‘Fear Among Delhi Traders’ : Delhi Traders Urge Sonia Gandhi To Delay INDIA Bloc Rally - The Times of India
source_excerpt: The Chamber of Trade and Industry (CTI) has written to Congress Parliamentary Party chairperson Sonia Gandhi, urging her to postpone the INDIA bloc's November 1 rally at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan until after Diwali. The traders' body has warned that the rally could disrupt business worth Rs 10,000â12,000 crore across 20 major markets in central Delhi, citing concerns over traffic congestion, parking and the movement of goods during the festive shopping season.Meanwhile, BJP MP Sanjay Jaiswal took a dig at Rahul Gandhi over the rally's timing, alleging that it was scheduled around his Vietnam trip. He also questioned asking party workers to travel to Delhi during the Diwali season.The INDIA bloc has called the 'Chalo Dilli Ramlila March' to protest against alleged vote tampering and raise concerns over democracy and the Constitution.
